tagline: A global leader in premium commercial real estate ownership and operation
hero_kpi_rationale: Direct operating costs increased by 12.8% year over year, reflecting operational pressures in the commercial real estate portfolio. This metric illustrates the challenges of managing premium real estate assets in a changing economic environment.

kpis.description: Direct costs for the three months ended March 31, 2026, significantly higher than in 2025, reflecting increased operational expenses across the real estate portfolio.

risks.title: Dependence on local economic conditions and real estate cycles
risks.score_rationale: Fundamental risk listed at the beginning of Item 3.D, strong language ("subject to", "cyclical nature"), directly affects asset valuations and rental income. Stable but structural trend in the commercial real estate sector.

risks.title: Office market transformation and hybrid remote work
risks.score_rationale: Sector-specific risk explicitly mentioned in Item 3.D with strong language ("sustained changes", "hybrid or remote work models"). Trend is rising, with major structural impact on office space demand.

risks.title: Default and insolvency of major tenants
risks.score_rationale: Explicit business risk in Item 3.D ("reliance on significant tenants", "tenant defaults, bankruptcies"). Moderate language but direct impact on cash flows. Critical dependence on high-quality tenants.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risks and data security incidents
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in Item 3.D ("cybersecurity failures and data security incidents"). Moderate language, growing operational risk for real estate managers. Trend is rising with increased digitization.

risks.title: Dependence on Brookfield and conflicts of interest
risks.score_rationale: Major structural risk, Item 3.D dedicated to Brookfield risks ("dependence on Brookfield", "conflicts of interests"). Brookfield holds 100% of LP Units. Explicit language on limited fiduciary duties. Stable but structural trend.

risks.title: Inability to renew or enter into new leases on favorable terms
risks.score_rationale: Explicit business risk in Item 3.D ("ability to renew or enter into new leases on favorable terms"). Direct impact on future revenues. Moderate language but structural risk tied to market conditions and competition.

risks.title: Force majeure events and uninsured losses
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk in Item 3.D ("force majeure events, uninsurable losses and higher insurance premiums"). Moderate language but potentially catastrophic impact. Trend is rising due to climate change and pandemics.

risks.title: Factors affecting the retail sector and consumer spending
risks.score_rationale: Segment-specific risk, Item 3.D explicitly states ("factors that affect the retail environment"). Detailed language listing unemployment, inflation, and consumer debt. Trend is rising amid current economic volatility.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the provided documents. The company operates in the commercial real estate sector and does not position AI as a strategic lever.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning, or advanced data technologies.
Strategy focused on real estate asset management and operations.
